description: Compact game-lane fan-out (PROTOCOL.md 6.7 WebSocket carriage / 14.6 WebTransport carriage), the egress mirror of the game:1 ingress twin in game-relay.json. Sibling of the frozen game-relay.json, keyed by the same fan-out case ids. payloadHex is the frozen value-codec payload [event, data, id?], byte-identical on both carriages. wtFrameHex is the fully deterministic WebTransport datagram frame [0x03][schemaVersion][0][seq][payload] (id 0 = the session's bound room). The WebSocket carriage's topicId is the per-connection wire-id binding (section 6.2) and is therefore NOT a fixed vector; the WebSocket carriage is asserted by decoding the payload + seq. A denial step produces no fan-out (fanout: null).
